Author: WayneXXDD
Name: Native Chat Tabs (Wayne, Testing)
Punchline: Two extra tabs inside the original chat window.
Description: Global client testing plugin. Adds a rounded pair of native tabs after the original chat controls, preserving the native add, settings and close buttons. Each extra tab selects its message types in /nct; the fourth native log panel remains the rendering slot.
Changelog: 0.1.5.0: Add extra default clearance after the native close button. Configure horizontal and vertical tab-pair offsets in /nct with immediate preview, saved settings, and a reset button. Move both tabs and rounded end caps together, and update their hit area while preserving original native geometry.
